headlines.title: Princes Group to buy Mondelez assets in France
headlines.summary: The deal includes the Heudebert, Pelletier, Cracotte and Grany brands under which Mondelez markets products including crispbreads and cereal bars.

headlines.title: Mondelez's Multi-Million Portfolio Shift: Unloads French Bakery and Cereal Bars Business
headlines.summary: Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) on Tuesday announced it would sell its French bread substitutes and cereal bars businesses to Princes Group PLC (OTC:PRNSY), an international platform in the U.K. and European food and beverage sector. The transaction involves four established French brands – Heudebert, Pelletier, Cracotte and Grany and three manufacturing facilities located in Granville, Vervins and Toulouse.

headlines.title: How Many Shares of Hershey or Mondelez Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about 2,066 Hershey shares (about $360,000) or about 5,770 Mondelez shares (about $389,700). Hershey’s higher yield makes it about $29,700 cheaper, and its dividend used 53% of free cash flow over the last 12 months, against 70% at Mondelez.

headlines.title: Why Mondelez Stock Stands Out As Rates Stay Higher For Longer
headlines.summary: Fed officials are again putting inflation and higher-for-longer rates at center stage, which forces every investor to rethink where reliable cash flows really matter. When borrowing costs stay elevated, companies with solid dividends and healthier balance sheets can look more attractive while weaker peers feel the squeeze. This article walks through three stocks from our U.S. Dividend and Value Stocks screener that appear closely tied to this rate story.

description: Mondelez International, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells snack food and beverage products in Latin America, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. The company provides biscuits and baked snacks, including cookies, crackers, salted snacks, snack bars, and cakes and pastries; chocolates; and gums and candies, as well as various cheese, grocery, and powdered beverage products. Its brand portfolio includes Oreo, Ritz, LU, CLIF Bar, Tate's Bake Shop biscuits and baked snacks, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, and Toblerone chocolate. It serves supermarket chains, wholesalers, supercenters, club stores, mass merchandisers, distributors, convenience stores, gasoline stations, drug stores, value stores, and other retail food outlets through direct store delivery, company-owned and satellite warehouses, distribution centers, third-party distributors, and other facilities, as well as through independent sales offices and agents. The company also sells products directly to businesses and consumers through e-retail platforms, retailer digital platforms, as well as through its direct-to-consumer websites and social media platforms. Mondelez International, Inc. was formerly known as Kraft Foods Inc. and changed its name to Mondelez International, Inc. in October 2012. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
